metadata.program: SkyraSoft HBOS Public Distribution & Multi-Tenant Platform Integrity Program

gaps.title: IndexedDB Local Store Un-namespaced Multi-Tenant Data Leakage
gaps.description: Local database name is static (HBOS_Local_Store_DB) and stores are shared globally on device. Logging out does not clear IndexedDB stores, allowing subsequent users on the same device/browser profile to access foreign tenant catalog, customer lists, and pending offline transactions.
gaps.target_remediation: Implement dynamic tenant-namespaced database naming (HBOS_Store_Biz_${id}) and explicit cache closure/eviction on logout.

gaps.title: Missing Tenantable Trait on SupplierReturn & ActivityLog Models
gaps.description: SupplierReturn and ActivityLog models contain business_id columns but omit the Tenantable trait and TenantScope. Direct model queries or relationship traversal without manual controller filtering could expose foreign tenant records.
gaps.target_remediation: Attach Tenantable trait to SupplierReturn and ActivityLog models.

gaps.title: Missing Rate Limiting on Public Self-Service Authentication Routes
gaps.description: Public /auth/login and /auth/register routes lack throttle middleware, exposing the platform to automated bot account creation, credential stuffing, and API resource exhaustion.
gaps.target_remediation: Attach strict throttle middleware (e.g., throttle:10,1 for register, throttle:6,1 for login) and failed-attempt tracking.

gaps.title: Missing Email Normalization on Registration and Login
gaps.description: Email inputs are not normalized to lowercase before validation and storage, allowing potential duplicate accounts or login failures due to case mismatch.
gaps.target_remediation: Enforce strtolower(trim($email)) in AuthController and User model.

gaps.title: Missing Self-Service Password Reset and Multi-Device Session Invalidation
gaps.description: HBOS lacks password reset endpoints (/auth/forgot-password, /auth/reset-password) and a "logout other devices" endpoint to revoke all Sanctum tokens upon credential change.
gaps.target_remediation: Implement secure password reset flow and multi-device session revocation endpoints.

gaps.title: Absence of Windows Desktop Shell Packaging for Microsoft Store Distribution
gaps.description: The client application exists only as a Vite web SPA. There is no configured native wrapper (e.g., Tauri or Electron or MSIX manifest) for Windows packaging, hardware API integration, or Microsoft Store ingestion.
gaps.target_remediation: Design and configure a lightweight, secure Windows desktop shell (Tauri / Electron MSIX) preserving native IndexedDB and thermal printer pipelines.

gaps.title: Missing Client-Server Version Handshake and Update Gating Headers
gaps.description: The backend does not validate incoming X-App-Version headers or emit min_supported_version / update_available metadata, making distributed client update management impossible.
gaps.target_remediation: Implement version negotiation middleware on API and client update notification handling in frontend.

gaps.title: Incomplete Initial Tenant Default Settings and Financial Structure Onboarding
gaps.description: Registration provisions a business and main branch, but fails to seed default cash accounts and essential business settings, causing blank states on fresh onboarding.
gaps.target_remediation: Seed initial "Main Cash" account and core receipt/invoice settings during atomic signup transaction.

gaps.title: Missing Multi-Business Creation for Existing Authenticated Users
gaps.description: An existing authenticated user cannot easily self-provision a second business tenant and switch contexts via a dedicated onboarding endpoint.
gaps.target_remediation: Provide an authenticated endpoint for creating additional business tenants under the same user identity.

gaps.title: Lack of Tenant Isolation in Uploaded Static File Paths
gaps.description: Uploaded store logos and assets do not strictly partition directories by business_id (e.g. storage/app/public/businesses/{id}/logo.png), risking path collisions across tenants.
